name: Table
description: Renders tabular data as a real HTML table — headers, rows, footer — at one 32px row track.

bordered.description: Draw the sheet: the surface plane, a hairline border and the surface radius

maxHeight.description: Bound the table's height: the wrapper scrolls on both axes and the head sticks to its top, filling its plane once rows pass under it

wrapperClassName.description: Class name for the outer scroll/wrapper container

wrapperProps.description: HTML attributes for the outer scroll/wrapper container

when: The data is static — read it, do not interact with it
The table needs a caption or a totals footer
whenNot: Rows need sorting, selection, or clicking (use DataTable)
Content is a single column of items (use List)
guidelines: Header cells go in Table.HeaderCell — it sets scope="col" for you
Give every table a caption or aria-label; visuallyHidden keeps it off screen
Every row is the 32px control track; there is no density or stripe option
Set maxHeight when the head must stay in view: the rows scroll inside the table and the head sticks; without it the page scrolls the rows and the head with them
The first column starts 12 in and every other cell pads 8, so content never meets a selected row's ring
Show an empty result with Table.Empty and a load with Table.Loading so the header stays real
Narrow viewports scroll the table sideways — keep column count low
accessibility: Semantic HTML table elements (thead, tbody, tfoot, th, td)
Column headers have scope="col" by default
Caption provides table description for screen readers
Supports visually-hidden caption for screen-reader-only labels

propsSummary: bordered: boolean - the sheet (surface plane, hairline, surface radius)
Table.Head, Table.Body, Table.Footer - section wrappers; the head is sticky and opaque
Table.Row - table row with optional selected prop (wash + inset ring)
Table.Cell - td element; tabularNums aligns digits
Table.Empty - full-width row with a compact EmptyState (colSpan required)
Table.Loading - placeholder rows, one bar per cell (columns, rows)
